title: The Repair Table
brief: Create a complete short practical ebook titled The Repair Table, for volunteers running a monthly community repair cafe. Write 1,200–1,600 useful words in three substantive chapters: receiving an item and agreeing its scope; organizing a safe, respectful repair conversation; recording the result and a clear handover. Use a clearly fictional small-appliance example without hazardous electrical repair instructions. Include a short introduction, contents, a reusable intake checklist, a worked before/after record, and a concise final checklist. Make it a readable 6×9 inch portrait ebook ready for PDF export. Choose a coherent visual identity suited to this subject; do not add invented endorsements, citations or missing image placeholders.

source.adaptation: Verbatim; the brief contains no Makeborne runtime lines.

mustHave: three substantive chapters: intake and scope, a safe respectful repair conversation, recording and handover
contents, short introduction, reusable intake checklist, worked before/after record and final checklist
no hazardous electrical repair instructions, invented endorsements, citations or image placeholders
notes: Prior outputs: outputs/fresh-product-quality-ac4b08bd-b91f-47bb-9956-c6d719505738/book. Closest direction: civic (community volunteers).
